## Perspective Audit Summary

**Component/artifact reviewed:** RevenueChart (Data Visualization With Color-Only Series Encoding)
**Perspectives escalated for deep review:** Magnification & Reflow, Environmental Contrast, Keyboard & Motor Access, Screen Reader & Semantic Structure
**Perspectives at LOW (not reviewed):** Vestibular & Motion Sensitivity, Auditory Access, Cognitive & Neurodivergent

### Findings by Severity

| Severity | Count |
|---|---|
| CRITICAL | 3 |
| MAJOR | 1 |
| MINOR | 0 |
| ENHANCEMENT | 0 |

### Perspectives That Passed

None. All escalated perspectives contain findings requiring remediation.

### Perspectives With Findings — Grouped by ARRM Role

**Visual Design**
- Color-only series encoding blocks colorblind users — Environmental Contrast — CRITICAL — 1.4.1 Use of Color
- Axis label text (~3.5:1) and legend swatch boundaries fail contrast/boundary requirements — Environmental Contrast — MAJOR — 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum)

**Front-End Dev**
- Fixed-width SVG and hardcoded font sizes break reflow and text scaling — Magnification & Reflow — MAJOR — 1.4.10, 1.4.4
- Chart bars lack `tabindex`, roles, or keyboard event handlers; tooltip is mouse-only — Keyboard & Motor Access — CRITICAL — 2.1.1, 2.4.7
- `<svg>` lacks `<title>`, `<desc>`, and accessible name/role mapping — Screen Reader & Semantic Structure — CRITICAL — 1.1.1, 4.1.2

**UX Design**
- Tooltip interaction pattern relies exclusively on hover state with no keyboard/focus alternative — Keyboard & Motor Access — CRITICAL — 2.5.1, 2.4.7

**Content Author**
- No adjacent data table or structured text alternative provided for the chart data — Screen Reader & Semantic Structure — CRITICAL — 1.1.1

### Open Questions Requiring Human Verification

None. All findings are code-level and enforceable from source review.

### Recommended Next Step

**BLOCK** — CRITICAL findings present (color-only encoding, unreachable keyboard targets, missing SVG semantics). Do not ship until resolved.

## Detailed Findings

### Magnification & Reflow
**Finding:** Fixed-width SVG (`width={CHART_W}`) and hardcoded `fontSize` attributes prevent content from reflowing to a single column at narrow viewports and block proportional text scaling during user zoom. Tooltip interaction relies exclusively on mouse hover, failing focus-triggered content requirements.
**WCAG:** 1.4.10 Reflow, 1.4.4 Resize Text, 1.4.13 Content on Hover or Focus
**Perspective:** Magnification & Reflow
**Severity:** MAJOR
**Route to:** Visual Design (secondary: Front-End Dev)
**Evidence:** `<svg width={CHART_W} height={...}>` enforces a fixed 600px viewport. SVG text uses hardcoded `fontSize="10"`. Tooltip relies exclusively on `onMouseEnter`/`onMouseLeave`.
**Fix:** Replace fixed dimensions with responsive `viewBox` and percentage widths. Add `tabindex="0"` and keyboard event handlers to bars for focus-triggered tooltips. Ensure SVG text scales proportionally with user zoom. `[Code-level]`

### Environmental Contrast
**Finding:** Chart bars are differentiated solely by `fill` color, violating the requirement that color never be the sole indicator of meaning. Axis labels use `fill="#666"` (~3.5:1 on white), falling below the 4.5:1 minimum for normal text. Legend swatches lack borders or shadows to establish clear boundaries in forced-colors mode.
**WCAG:** 1.4.1 Use of Color, 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum)
**Perspective:** Environmental Contrast
**Severity:** CRITICAL
**Route to:** Visual Design (secondary: Front-End Dev)
**Evidence:** Bars use `fill="#1565c0"`, `#2e7d32`, `#e65100`, `#6a1b9a`, `#c62828` with no patterns, textures, or direct data labels. Axis text uses `fill="#666"`. Legend swatches are 12x12px with no border/shadow.
**Fix:** Add patterns, textures, or direct data labels to bars. Increase axis label text contrast to ≥4.5:1. Add a 1px border or drop shadow to legend swatches to ensure boundary visibility in forced-colors mode. `[Code-level]`

### Keyboard & Motor Access
**Finding:** SVG `<rect>` elements representing chart bars are completely unreachable by keyboard. They lack `tabindex`, ARIA roles, and keyboard event listeners (`onKeyDown`). The tooltip only triggers on mouse hover, leaving keyboard users unable to access data values.
**WCAG:** 2.1.1 Keyboard, 2.4.7 Focus Visible
**Perspective:** Keyboard & Motor Access
**Severity:** CRITICAL
**Route to:** Front-End Dev (secondary: UX Design)
**Evidence:** `<rect>` elements in SVG have no `tabindex`, `role`, or keyboard event listeners (`onKeyDown`). Tooltip triggers only on mouse hover.
**Fix:** Add `role="img"` or `role="listitem"` with `tabindex="0"` to bars, implement `onKeyDown` for Enter/Space to show tooltip, ensure focus indicator is visible in forced-colors mode. `[Code-level]`

### Screen Reader & Semantic Structure
**Finding:** The `<svg>` element functions as a complex data visualization but lacks an accessible name (`<title>`, `aria-label`) and descriptive context (`<desc>`). Screen readers will announce only "SVG", providing zero information about the chart's purpose or data. No adjacent structured text alternative (e.g., data table) is present.
**WCAG:** 1.1.1 Non-text Content, 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value
**Perspective:** Screen Reader & Semantic Structure
**Severity:** CRITICAL
**Route to:** Front-End Dev (secondary: Content Author)
**Evidence:** `<svg>` lacks `<title>` and `<desc>`. No `aria-label` or `role="img"` with accessible name. Data is purely visual.
**Fix:** Add `<title id="chart-title">Q1 2026 Revenue by Region</title>` and `<desc>` inside SVG. Provide a visible/hidden data table alternative adjacent to the chart. `[Code-level]`
